findings: New catalog template authored from a public tiered-huddle demonstration; no prior library source existed and no files from that demonstration were copied.
The demonstrated pattern pairs a conversational surface with a board and a Dataverse store; the library needs a portable single-file agent with the same four promises.
Escalation, paging and closure are external actions in the demonstrated pattern and must not run from a synthetic template.
fixes: Authored a single-file, stdlib-only agent with 4 deterministic operations over an invented hospital snapshot behind one marked data-plane seam.
Represented every escalation, page, closure and decision as a labeled draft or recommendation with an explicit no-action gate; clocks are relative hours, never calendar dates.
Used only a fictional hospital, units, people, roles and identifiers; the board carries operational issues and no patient data.
Added one locked persona-language case and one uploadable skill per operation.
remaining_boundary: Production connections and all external actions require customer approval, least-privilege controls, and an authorized human workflow.
